items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: I used to pal with the guitar player, Freddie Guy.

ctx.x: Did you have any special good friend in the band -- any strong friendship with any particular musician?
I used to pal with the guitar player, Freddie Guy. He and I -- well we didn't socialize. I never drank at all and so we usually stayed close to the person that did the same thing you did.
I didn't even play bridge, which was a reason for staying to myself most of the time. Everybody played bridge. And I couldn't stand it.
